name: Starlight Clockwork Orchard
description: An orchard where each tree is a brass‑gear mechanism bearing fruit that glows like tiny stars, ticking in harmony with the night sky.
prompt: Orchard at midnight: trees with copper trunks and gear‑like branches. Fruit are miniature glowing stars, pulsing gently. Ground littered with brass cogs. Sky dense with stars. Detailed steampunk aesthetic, high resolution, 8k.
caption: Harvest the night, one tick at a time. ⭐⚙️ #StarlightClockworkOrchard
